method_reuse.policy: Use exact existing frozen calibration analyzer without modifying formulas, thresholds, masks, color handling or regions. Supply new independent plain-scroll index; preserve earlier synthetic-scroll results.

preinspection.scope: Feasibility image review and fixed unoccluded ROI only, documented in foreground-review.json; this is calibration, not a blinded independent test.

index_gate: New native method, fixture hashes, plain-scroll config, no touch, parent/scroll geometry and stable identities; fixed statusbar and full actual one-test/sixteen-session completeness must pass before analysis.
comparison_policy: Report paired conditional responses and absolute control/shape errors at fixed observed pixels. Preserve effective themes, nominal-layer labels, uncertainty and all failures. No gain fit, scene registration or timing correction.
